name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and obtained a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.

Steps taken:
1. Verified the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable was already set in the sandbox.
2. Attempted the exact curl command from the quickstart docs using model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but received a "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed" error.
3. Listed available models via the API to find an accessible model.
4. Used the available model "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2" in the same curl request format.
5. Received a successful chat completion response: {"id":"chatcmpl-18452d595efd4c3883c4013ed42a80f1",...,"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hello in Spanish is **Hola**."...}}]}

The promised outcome (a chat completion returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API) is verified.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a NOT_FOUND error. I had to substitute an available model ("accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2") to successfully complete the API call. Otherwise, the request format (endpoint, headers, payload structure) followed the docs exactly.

env_ready.evidence: /usr/bin/curl is present and curl 8.14.1 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu) is installed

installed.evidence: No Fireworks SDK or CLI installation command appears in the transcript; only system curl is used

first_call.evidence: First chat completion curl returned {"error":{"message":"Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"...}

verified.evidence: Final curl returned {"object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Hello in Spanish is **Hola**."}}]}

friction.detail: The quickstart's suggested model fails with {"error":{"message":"Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"...} when using "model": "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1".
The second suggested model also returns {"error":{"message":"Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"...} for "model": "accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct".
The agent had to manually call curl https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models because the quickstart does not list currently accessible models.
The API error Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed conflates three different problems, making it hard to diagnose why the documented model failed.
The transcript shows the key was already present (FIREWORKS_API_KEY is set: yes), hiding the Step 1: Create and export an API key friction a first-time user would face.
